summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K to report a press release announcing new analysis of Phase 2 trial data for ATH434 in Multiple System Atrophy, presented at a scientific conference. The filing contains no transaction, no change in control, no capital structure alteration, and no corporate event qualifying as a special situation. It is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results by a foreign private issuer. No deal terms, consideration, or premiums are present. This is a standard R&D pipeline update without actionable event-driven characteristics.
